title: Webhook
description: HTTP triggers for agent threads. Every webhook.http trigger instance is bound to a thread and exposed on a public POST endpoint; a request wakes the thread with the payload text. A busy thread reports queued-behind-active-run, a paused instance reports paused.

sections.body: Every webhook is a trigger instance bound to a thread and a public POST endpoint. Send a JSON body like {"text": "..."} (or any raw text) to wake the thread; the response is 202 with the fire status. A paused instance reports paused, a thread with an active run reports queued-behind-active-run. The endpoint is unauthenticated: anyone with the URL can wake the thread, so treat the URL as a secret.
